  2. b.Authorization to Submit an Out-of-Cycle Travel & Tourism Grant Application for the 2027 Music in the Mountains Series - Up to $32,000 from FY27 and FY28 Funds:

    Suggested Motion: Motion to authorize staff to submit an out-of-cycle application to the Town of Alpine Travel and Tourism Board for the 2027 Music in the Mountains series in an amount up to $32,000, including a request for approval of $8,000 from FY27 Travel and Tourism funds for the June band bookings, and $24,000 for FY28 Travel & Tourism funds for the July through September bookings subject to available funding and grant approval.

    • 2026.09.28 Events Committee Staff Report Music in the Mountains Summer 2027 Series Out-of-Cycle Grant Request.pdf (0.29 MB)

  3. c.Approval of an Additional $3,500 in FY27 Expenses for the 2027 Music in the Mountains Summer Series, Increasing the Authorized Amount to $23,500, with the Increase Funded from Prior-Year Fund Balance:

    Suggested Motion: Motion to approve an additional $3,500 in FY27 expenses for the Music in the Mountains 2027 Summer Series, increasing the total authorized amount from $20,000 to $23,500, and to fund the $3,500 increase from the prior-year fund balance

    • 2023.09.28 Events Committee Staff Report Music in the Mountains increase in expenses.pdf (0.05 MB)

12.PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment is limited to a total of 20 minutes, with each speaker allowed up to 3 minutes. This is an opportunity to address the Council on any topic.
